runs.text: Summary of 2026 principal academic dates for Australian universities
For updates to this data visit universitiesaustralia.edu.au
The University of Notre Dame Australia* ^ (u)

Source: Universities Australia 2025 collection of data on 2025-26 academic dates (data provided by individual universities). This table reflects principal dates for the standard teaching sessions of each university. This document is NOT intended to fully represent the official academic/operating calendar of individual universities – please refer to their calendars for details.

Many universities now teach outside the periods shown, particularly through winter sessions during June and July (indicated by *). Individual faculties within universities (often Business, Medicine, Health Sciences, Visual Arts and Education) may operate by different timetables.

^ Summer session is offered only for a limited number of degree programs or individual subjects, which can start and finish anytime during the period. N/A indicates an ad-hoc/integrated exam period within the session.
For universities operating under a two semester model, "Autumn Session" is Semester 1 and "Spring Session" is Semester 2.
# University operates under a three session (trimester) model, ie. summer session is a formal teaching period for all students.
(b) UNSW Sydney operates on a three term model, with an additional optional intensive Summer Term.

(c) The University of Newcastle also operates formal trimesters from 26 Jan to 24 Apr with exam period 27-01 May; 11 May to 31 July with exam period 03 -07 Aug; 17 Aug to 13 Nov with exam period 16-20 Nov.

(d) The University of Sydney also offers some courses – known as Intensive Units – over Summer (January and February 2024) and Winter (July 2024), with no published exam period as the examination dates/requirements vary by course. STUVAC is between 27-31 May in the Autumn Session and 4-8 November in the Spring Session.

(e) University of Technology Sydney utilises 8 calendars. The dates provided here are for the main teaching calendar. Other calendars are used specifically for Health, Education, GSH, PG Online and UTS Parallel, Short Sessions and HDR.

UOW also operates a formal Trimester model for postgraduate business programs. The 2025 Trimesters are as follows: Trimester 1 is from 10 Feb to 18 Apr with exam period 26 Apr to 02 May; Trimester 2 from 19 May to 25 Jul with exam period 2 Aug to 8 Aug; Trimester 3 from 25 Aug to 31 Oct with exam period 8 Nov to 20 Nov.
(g) Federation University Australia also operates late summer, winter and spring teaching periods for a limited number of courses.

(m) No formal summer semester period, however a select number of individual subjects are offered.

(n) The University of the Sunshine Coast delivers two main teaching semesters and also offers trimesters and smaller (8 week) teaching sessions throughout the year where a select number of courses are on offer.

(q) Subject to change: The University of Western Australia will operate formal trimesters from 24 Jan to 14 Apr, with exam period from 16 Apr to 23 Apr; 2 May to 22 Jul with exam period from 23 Jul to 30 Jul; 22 Aug to11 Nov with exam period from 12 to 18 Nov

(r) The University of Adelaide offers formal trimesters 29 January  – 26 April, with exam period from 2 May to 4 May; 20 May – 16 August with exam period from 22 to 24 August; 2 Sept to 22 Nov with exam period from 28 Nov to 7 Dec and a Winter Semester from 24 Jun-17 July, with an exam period from 18 Jul to 20 Jul.

(s) University of Canberra will operate a formal mid-year term (winter) from 27 May to 12 July, with exam period from 15 Jul to 27 July, along with a number of other intensive teaching periods. A limited summer teaching period will apply in 2023/24.
(t) Australian Catholic University offers a winter term from 20 May to 28 July 2024
(u) The University of Notre Dame Australia offers a winter term from 17 June 2024 until 05 July 2024 with exams from 08 July until 13 July 2024.
(v) Charles Darwin University delivers six (6) intensive teaching periods that include a *Dry and Wet Season as well as the two (2) formal Semesters

(w) University of Tasmania also operates trimesters for select Business and Health programs. Date ranges vary by program but generally run as Period 1 from mid Jan to late Apr; Period 2 from mid May to mid Aug; Period 3 from end Aug to early Dec.

(w) The Australian National University operates in semester 1 between 17 February to 23 may 2025, and semester 2 between 21 July to 24 October 2025. The “non-semester based” teaching sessions (Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spring) do not operate on the model of pre-defined examination periods, and hence they are left blank.

(y) The teaching period for University of Melbourne's Summer Term and Winter Term subjects, and the other intensive subjects offered across the year, vary. Specific dates are provided in the subject entries in the University Handbook.
(z) The dates provided are for the main intakes being semester 1 and 2. Monash also offers a November intake and other teaching periods including Summer.

(aa) The University of Southern Queensland will transition to a flexible academic calendar with five different length study periods between 2023 and 2025. In 2023, selected programs will be delivered in trimester and block calendars. Dates provided are the current semester based calendar.
(nn) The 2025/26 Summer Session dates are subject to change with the merger of UniSA with the University of Adelaide.
